about: Made-up dive log for teaching, not a record of an actual dive. Generated by make_dive.py. One row per second for 40 minutes at 1 frame per second.

units.light: relative to surface, 1.0 = full daylight at the surface
units.detection: species id from species.json or null

attenuation.source: Assumption in the range of turbid coastal water. Kratzer et al. (2003), Ambio 32(8):577-585, doi:10.1639/0044-7447(2003)032[0577:ASAPZD]2.0.CO;2 report Kd(490) of 0.33 to 0.92 per metre in coastal Baltic Sea water and Kd(490) = 1.48 * Kd(PAR). No Mumbai value was found.

detector: A made-up detector. It reports a species when confidence reaches 0.30.
